summary: npm package used as CDN vehicle for a mutable browser redirect script
details: The package's main file px.js is a browser-only script that injects a full-viewport iframe pointing at https://mfmz.hb0x4y.cn/H.html. It has no npm lifecycle hooks and cannot be used via Node require() (references document/DOM globals that are undefined in Node). A maintenance script update_px8my.sh shipped in the tarball automates rotating the redirect domain inside px.js, bumping the patch version, republishing to npm, and purging jsDelivr caches — indicating the package exists to distribute a mutable browser redirector through the jsDelivr CDN mirror of npm. The maintenance script is not wired to any lifecycle hook and does not run on install. Installing or requiring this package in a Node build pipeline does not exfiltrate installer data, execute code on the installer, or drop persistence; the redirect only fires against browser visitors of pages that embed the jsDelivr URL for this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
